title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Undivided in Every Room
caption:
Loud with the guys. Serious with God. Most men think those two have to be different people.

They don't. A godly man is undivided, not uniform. Same conscience whether he's in the pew or the group chat.

What it actually looks like: no Sunday voice and Saturday voice, what he does unwatched is what he actually believes, undivided doesn't mean boring, and the room doesn't get to pick who shows up.

James called the divided man unstable in everything he does. This is what stable looks like instead.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #integrity #discipleship
